units.source_text: 听说两三天以后，他的这个朋友在去某温泉旅馆的途中，竟然把玫瑰花吃了。

en.t: It is said that two or three days later, while on his way to a certain hot-spring inn, this friend of his actually ate the rose.

units.source_text: 这个朋友住院后，他想起自己以前曾送给过这个朋友一座赤陶半身像。

en.t: After this friend was hospitalized, he remembered that he had once given him a terracotta bust.

units.source_text: 那是这个朋友所喜欢的《钦差大臣》一书的作者的半身像。

en.t: It was a bust of the author of The Government Inspector, a book this friend liked.

units.source_text: 他想起果戈理也是发疯而死，不由得感有一股神奇的力量在支配着他们。

en.t: Remembering that Gogol too had gone mad and died, he could not help feeling that some mysterious power was governing them.
